</p><p class="MsoNormal">All

<p>The ground floor commercial premises located in the rear extension, as proposed, shall be used only as flexible E(c)(i, ii and iii) and/or E(g))(i, ii and iii) uses and for no other purposes, unless an alternative use is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;<br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><div><br></div>
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further details
of the indicated cycle parking, such as its enclosure, have been submitted to,
and approved in writing by the local planning authority, to ensure it is covered,
accessible and secure. The development shall be carried out in accordance with
the details as so agreed, and the storage provision shall be in place prior to
the first usage of the development, and retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding any hereby approved
plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of
accessible, screened refuse and recycling storage (including relevant
enclosures) has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local
planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
details as so agreed, and the storage provision shall be in place prior to the
first occupation of the development. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored
at all times, other than on collection days, within the thereby approved
designated refuse storage area<br></p>

<p>Prior to
occupation, details of the provision of green/biodiverse roof shall been
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
details to be submitted shall comprise:<o:p></o:p></p><p>a) details of
the planting and substrate to be used, such as a manufacturer’s specification<o:p></o:p></p><p>b) details of
the maintenance including irrigation.<o:p></o:p></p><p>The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and
shall be retained and maintained as such thereafter.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further details of the boundary treatment, including its design, height and materials, to be erected in association with the rear garden subdivision has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The boundary treatment shall be completed before the development is occupied&nbsp;in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</span></span><br></p>
description: Single storey rear extension for use as a self-contained office (Use class E)
